shellCommands.command: ls node_modules/.bin/next 2>/dev/null && echo EXISTS || echo MISSING
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -80

npx next start -p 3100 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/
cat /tmp/next-start.log

echo "--- Prefetch request for featured (should be instant, full content, no 800ms wait) ---"
time curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=featured" | tr -d '\0'
echo
echo "--- Prefetch request for sale ---"
time curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" | tr -d '\0'

curl -s -D - -o /tmp/resp1.txt -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=featured"
echo "---BODY---"
cat -A /tmp/resp1.txt | head -50

time curl -s -L -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=featured" -o /tmp/featured.rsc
echo "size: $(wc -c < /tmp/featured.rsc)"
cat /tmp/featured.rsc
echo
echo "=== sale ==="
time curl -s -L -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale" -o /tmp/sale.rsc
echo "size: $(wc -c < /tmp/sale.rsc)"
cat /tmp/sale.rsc
curl -s -v -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=featured&_rsc=abc123" 2>&1 | head -60
curl -s -v -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=featured&_rsc=HEAvJdHAQJrUAe2K" 2>&1 | head -80
ls node_modules | grep -i playwright; ls node_modules | grep -i puppeteer; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; npx playwright --version 2>&1 | head -5
timeout 60 npx playwright install chromium --with-deps 2>&1 | tail -30
timeout 90 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -30

npm ls playwright 2>/dev/null; PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/home/vercel-sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright node /tmp/test-prefetch.mjs 2>&1 || (npm install --no-save playwright >/tmp/pw-install.log 2>&1 && node /tmp/test-prefetch.mjs)
mkdir -p /tmp/pw-test && cd /tmp/pw-test && npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm install playwright@1.63.0 >/tmp/pw-install.log 2>&1; tail -5 /tmp/pw-install.log

cp /tmp/test-prefetch.mjs /tmp/pw-test/test-prefetch.mjs
cd /tmp/pw-test && node test-prefetch.mjs
which apk yum dnf 2>/dev/null; cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -5; ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -i nspr
whoami; id; sudo -n true 2>&1 && echo "sudo ok" || echo "no sudo"
sudo dnf install -y nspr nss nss-util at-spi2-atk cups-libs libdrm libxkbcommon libXcomposite libXdamage libXfixes libXrandr mesa-libgbm pango alsa-lib 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /tmp/pw-test && node test-prefetch.mjs
cd /tmp/pw-test && sed -i "s/page.locator('main').innerText()/page.locator('main').last().innerText()/g" test-prefetch.mjs && node test-prefetch.mjs
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; jobs -l 2>/dev/null; echo done
